title: Blameless Incident Postmortem
summary: Master Blameless Incident Postmortem through explanation, prediction, implementation, and review.

challenges.title: Recall checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Without reopening the lesson, explain Blameless Incident Postmortem in your own words. Include the problem it solves, the core mechanism, and one boundary or failure.
challenges.hint: Use “Executive summary” as a cue, then close the lesson again.

challenges.title: Prediction checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Choose one example or source file from this mission. Predict its behavior for a normal input and a changed or invalid input before running or revealing the reference. Explain the rule separating the outcomes.
challenges.hint: Change one condition at a time so the result teaches a rule.

challenges.title: Build and prove checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Implement, debug, or adapt the mission exercise yourself. Record the acceptance criterion, command or interaction used to verify it, failure evidence, and one tradeoff. Do not paste the reference solution.
challenges.hint: A passing check, measured result, focused diff, or reproducible demo is stronger than ‘done.’

## Executive summary

What happened, who was affected, for how long, and current status?

## Impact

Use measured user/system impact. Distinguish confirmed facts from estimates.

## Detection

What signal detected the problem? If a user found it first, what signal was
missing or ineffective?

|---|---|
| | |

## Technical narrative

Explain the causal chain in enough detail that another engineer can learn from
it. Avoid reducing the cause to “human error.”
